fields.title: Every atomic rename in the main process retries a transient Windows lock
fields.description: Seven temp-then-rename writes in `main/` call `fsPromises.rename` directly, so a scanner's brief lock fails them outright. Export `renameWithRetry` from `main/json-store.js` and route all seven through it, with no new retry code.
